scenario.title: Stable period, margin to the specification
scenario.expect: A low sulfur forecast leaves room under the 10 mg/kg chance constraint, so the admissible set is non-empty and the optimiser only fine-tunes the regime, with every hard constraint satisfied. This state is RARE: it holds in 4 of 53 640 held-out operating samples with a fresh laboratory result. The unit spends almost all of its time unable to certify the limit at 95% confidence.

stable.headline: Increase R-201 outlet temperature (HDS reactor) 372.3674 -> 372.4182 degC (+1 more)

scenario.title: Operating at the specification limit
scenario.expect: The forecast plus the statistical back-off of eq 63 exceeds 10 mg/kg: the admissible set is empty, so the system falls back to the lexicographic risk-reduction stage and states plainly that the limit is not certified.

at_limit.headline: Risk reduction only -- increase R-201 outlet temperature (HDS reactor) 373.5028 -> 374.9329 degC; the 10 mg/kg limit is NOT certified; attainable confidence 79%

scenario.title: Stale laboratory data
scenario.expect: The last laboratory sulfur result is over 300 h old and the stream analyser cannot stand in, so the freshness clause of eq 66 fails and the system refuses.
